claims: The IMF's April 2026 World Economic Outlook projects 2026 global growth at 3.1%.
Goldman Sachs estimates 2026 global growth at 2.9%.
According to the IMF blog, the war in the Middle East is significantly increasing uncertainty.
According to the IMF blog, the war in the Middle East is pushing up energy prices.
According to the IMF blog, the war in the Middle East is threatening to cause stagflationary pressures.
According to the IMF blog, there is a risk of global growth falling to 2.5% if disruptions intensify.
As stated in the WEO press briefing, global inflation is reaching 4.4% in the baseline scenario.
Latin America expects slow growth of 2.3%.
Key downsides include higher oil prices ($110-$150 range).
